children: Wall Street looked to regain some momentum on Friday, after the AI trade came under pressure on Thursday.

Tech shares came under pressure on Thursday amid revenue concerns surrounding OpenAI. Reports indicated that OpenAI's annualized revenue reached $50 billion at the end of September, below the $68 billion figure reported the previous month.
On the economic front, investors will monitor the consumer sentiment report for further clues on household confidence and the economic outlook.
